india.one_line: India sees new AI models, partnerships, and international cooperation.

themes.title: Chariot releases multilingual speech model
themes.text: Chariot launched Chariot‑1‑ASR Realtime, a speech‑to‑text model supporting ten Indian languages and Indian English, reporting lower error rates across 79 public test sets.

stories.headline: Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages

themes.title: Tech Mahindra partners with SpaceXSI
themes.text: Tech Mahindra announced a collaboration with AI coding platform SpaceXSI to modernise legacy applications, accelerate delivery and improve developer productivity for global enterprises.

stories.headline: Tech Mahindra partners with SpaceXSI to boost AI‑assisted software engineering

themes.title: Polish prime minister seeks AI ties
themes.text: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called for deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India, proposing joint AI development and inviting Indian firms to joint ventures at the Global Investors Meet 2027.

stories.headline: Polish prime minister calls for deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India

themes.title: LTM opens AI lab in Chennai
themes.text: LTM launched the BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai to enable clients, partners and its teams to develop, simulate and validate AI solutions for industrial operations before deployment.

stories.headline: LTM launches BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai
